scope: Fresh synthetic mechanism intervention on exact original sparse_tick, not original Agentd qualification or a full NDU training claim
head_features: intercept + ten second-tick activation values + ten second-tick eligibility values, each Q24 scaled
head_training_label: Actual target-free paired delivered repair gain positive, before/after artifacts both reopened
kernel: Exact original sparse_tick, fixed width10/top_k2/config; no kernel parameter updates
scalar_path: Readback-derived scalar -> two-channel fixed drive -> first sparse_tick checkpoint -> zero-drive second sparse_tick -> activation and eligibility only -> fitted readout -> repair or stop
primary_comparisons: numeric minus zero mean net return
numeric minus state_reset mean net return
interval_scope: Synthetic paired episode draws conditional on one trained head; two prespecified primary comparisons, no training-seed or natural-source population inference
shared_budget: Every arm gets two real sparse_tick calls, one common frozen trained head, same public readback, at most two delivered four-file bundles; realized repair cost and native/wall time reported separately
state_reset_intervention: Numeric first tick executes, then its checkpoint is discarded; second tick starts from None with zero drive. Both native calls still execute. This is an explicit research intervention, never a production reset.
shuffle_control: All first bundles are delivered and read back before shuffling actual committed numeric feedback across cases; exactly preserved empirical scalar marginal
history_control: Same public readback and native/head compute; registered direct mismatch-penalty versus repair-cost decision; numeric superiority is not presumed
inherited_task: Frozen risk_feedback/PROTOCOL.json and evidence/PARAMETERS.json, file hashes registered before fresh outcomes
initial_action: Risk profile using the previously trained categorical posterior; identical for all five arms
private_target_visibility: Only private scoring after final file receipt; never passed to native request or continuation readout
media_scope: Actual UTF8 text, PNG, tone PCM WAV, and uncompressed AVI semantic codecs; not learned natural speech/video
stopping_rule: One fresh registered run; retain negative controls and all episodes; no evaluation-driven head/kernel tuning
